# Model selection

Choose a model using its cross-validation results and assign it to `final_model`.
Explain your choice here.

```{r select-model}
final_model <- models[[model_comparison$model[1]]]
cat("Selected model:", model_comparison$model[1], "\n")
```

## Important features

```{r classification-functions, code=readLines("R/visualization/importance.R"), fold="Feature importance", message=FALSE}
source("R/visualization/importance.R", local = TRUE, print.eval = TRUE)
```

```{r feature-importance}
plot_feature_importance(final_model, top = 30)
```
